{{< video videos/dna_styles.mp4 >}}

B-DNA (1BNA). The cartoon's `Base Shape` gives the slab and stick looks; ProteinMotion's
     ring and ladder styles have no cartoon equivalent yet. Residues 5 to 8 of chain A are
     painted, chain B fades through a transparent material, and the scene ends on a molecular
     surface.

After ProteinMotion's [`dna_styles.py`](https://github.com/pdpppd/proteinmotion/blob/main/examples/dna_styles.py).

## Script

Run it with `uv run python docs/examples/timeline/scripts/dna_styles.py out_dir`; set
`MN_EXAMPLES_QUICK=1` for a small, fast check. The script is included from the file:

```{.python filename="scripts/dna_styles.py"}
{{< include scripts/dna_styles.py >}}
```
